comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Grace default 48h approved by security review draft.

content.text: Grace default 48h approved by security review draft.
Rotating a webhook secret today is a hard cutover: partners must update verifiers at the same instant we switch signing keys, which causes signature failures during deploys.

Support setting a next_secret while current_secret remains valid. For a configurable grace period (default 48h), deliveries are signed with next_secret and verification on our test endpoint accepts either secret. After grace, current is replaced and next cleared.
Acceptance: admin API to begin/commit/cancel rotation; delivery headers include X-Nimbus-Signature-Version so consumers know which key was used; audit log entries for each rotation step.
